name: evidence-card-viewport-stability
goal: Keep component screenshot frames at a consistent 4:3 card size across desktop, tablet, and mobile captures while containing each original image without distortion.

evidence: Existing EntityScreens renders each captured screenshot at width 100% and height auto. The 1440×900 desktop, 920×800 tablet, and 390×844 mobile sources therefore change the screenshot card height when selected. Expected: a shared 4:3 frame at the same available width, with each source fully contained and no distortion; portrait captures receive side gutters. Reproduce at the TitleList component detail and select each Viewport control.

The standardized explorer evidence E2E test selected Mobile but asserted only that an image existed. It never compared the screenshot frame geometry after viewport selection or checked object-fit. Strengthen that same browser flow using the seeded 1440×900, 920×800, and 390×844 captures; assert a common 4:3 frame, contained images, unchanged frame dimensions while switching, and measurable mobile side gutters.
The committed cross-viewport E2E fails before the style repair at 1.5965:1 instead of 4:3; recorded by the clean-snapshot red phase at ff048bf.
The 9edf78d fix adds one shared 4:3 screenshot frame with contained images and centered side gutters; it also extracts the existing component-only audio route check without changing routing.

The unchanged cross-viewport browser regression passes on 9edf78d in the same normalized environment as the red run, with all 4:3 geometry, image-containment, equal-size, and mobile-gutter assertions satisfied.
